scholarships.title: MBZUAI Graduate Funding for M.Sc. and Ph.D. Students
scholarships.official_source: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI)

existing.description: MBZUAI's graduate funding is not a single named scholarship but a University-and-faculty funding model under which funded M.Sc. and Ph.D. students receive free tuition fees, a monthly stipend, one return airfare each year to their home country, health insurance for the approved funding period, and a University-sponsored UAE residence visa and Emirates ID where eligible. Ph.D. Year 1 funding is centrally funded by the University while the student is matched with a faculty advisor, and funding moves to the faculty advisor's funding no later than the start of Year 2. M.Sc. students are fee-paying by default and funding is secured through a faculty advisor-sponsored research or teaching assistantship, or an approved government scholarship for UAE nationals, with merit-based funding considered during the admissions review process. The Master in Applied Artificial Intelligence is a fee-based programme and is not eligible for University or faculty-sponsored funding.
eligibility: Degree in a STEM field such as computer science, electrical engineering, computer engineering, mathematics, physics, or other relevant science or engineering majors
From an accredited university or college recognized by the UAE Ministry of Education (MoE)
Minimum CGPA of 3.0 or 3.5 (on a scale of 4.0) depending on the program
Senior-level students can apply initially with a copy of their transcript and, upon admission, must submit the official complete degree certificate and transcript
A degree attestation for degrees from the UAE, or a Certificate of Recognition for degrees acquired outside the UAE, should be furnished within the first semester at MBZUAI
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must hold a degree in a STEM field such as computer science, electrical engineering, computer engineering, mathematics, physics or another relevant science or engineering major from an accredited university or college recognized by the UAE Ministry of Education, with a minimum CGPA of 3.0 or 3.5 on a 4.0 scale depending on the program.
benefits: Ph.D. Year 1 funding is centrally funded by the University while matching with a faculty advisor
University-sponsored UAE residence visa and Emirates ID (where eligible)
Return airfare to the home country once per year, rather than a one-time flight
coverage: Free tuition fees for funded students
One return airfare each year to the student's home country
Health insurance for the approved funding period
University-sponsored UAE residence visa and Emirates ID (where eligible)
requirements: Submit only one application per admission cycle; multiple submissions will not be processed
Take the technical interview if invited
documents: Copy of transcript (senior-level applicants may apply with a copy of their transcript)
Official complete degree certificate and transcript, required upon admission
Degree attestation (UAE degrees) or Certificate of Recognition (degrees acquired outside the UAE), to be furnished within the first semester
application_method: Choose your admission pathway on the MBZUAI admissions page (undergraduate, graduate master's, or graduate Ph.D.)
Submit one application through the MBZUAI application portal for the cycle, observing the single-application rule
Upload the curriculum vitae, statement of purpose, research statement and supporting documents
Prepare for and complete the screening exam
Take the technical interview if invited
Wait for the decision notification date published for the programme
existing.selection_notes: Applicants are evaluated on academic excellence, technical preparation, research potential, and alignment with their chosen program. Admission to MBZUAI is highly competitive with limited places available in each incoming cohort; MBZUAI states that forty-three percent of its incoming graduate students for the 2026-2027 academic year came from the world's top computer science universities. Funding decisions for M.Sc. students depend on whether a faculty advisor sponsors a research or teaching assistantship or, for UAE nationals, an approved government scholarship, with merit-based funding considered during the admissions review process.
existing.best_fit: Graduate applicants to MBZUAI's M.Sc. or Ph.D. programmes in computer science, electrical or computer engineering, mathematics, physics or another relevant science or engineering major who hold a STEM degree with a minimum CGPA of 3.0 or 3.5 on a 4.0 scale depending on the programme.
existing.notes: M.Sc. students are fee-paying by default and funding is NOT guaranteed for all admitted students; students without a funding source are classified as fee-paying. Ph.D. funding is subject to a confirmed advisor match and satisfactory progress, and transitions to the faculty advisor's funding no later than the start of Year 2. Funded students are expected to maintain an in-person presence on campus throughout their funded period and to obtain approval before being away. Students receiving external scholarships or fellowships must disclose this funding to the University; external funding normally replaces the University stipend rather than being paid in addition to it. The Master in Applied Artificial Intelligence (MAAI) is fee-based at AED 5,000 per credit, 34 credit hours, total tuition AED 170,000 (approx. USD 46,291), and is not eligible for University or faculty-sponsored funding. Cost of Attendance figures for Fall 2027 for unfunded M.Sc. students are currently being finalized and were not published on the page at the time of verification. An English language waiver exists and is described on the MBZUAI admissions FAQ, but the minimum score thresholds are published only on programme-specific pages, so no score is recorded here.
existing.application_period: Application portal opened 7 September 2026, 8a.m. GST for all graduate programs except M.Sc. and Ph.D. Computational Biology, which opened 30 September 2026, 8a.m. GST. Portal closes 15 December 2026, 5p.m. GST (MAAI: 28 February 2027).
existing.deadline_display: Final application deadline 15 December 2026, 5p.m. GST for all graduate programs except the Master in Applied Artificial Intelligence (28 February 2027 for MAAI); decision notification 31 March 2027; offer response deadline 15 April 2027
